snippet.title: Iron Force - Available now on the App Store!
snippet.description:
DOWNLOAD NOW ON THE APP STORE: http://bit.ly/1bkkOuj

Take part in epic, explosive multiplayer tank battles in Iron Force. Join forces with your friends in team-based battles, or have a free-for-all. 

PLEASE NOTE THIS GAME REQUIRES A STABLE INTERNET CONNECTION TO PLAY 

EPIC ONLINE ACTION 
Iron Force puts you in the boots of a tank commander. Roll out in your armored goliath and take down anyone who stands in your way. Dive into 6-player free for all fights, or team up and take to the field in games of 3 vs 3. 

YOUR TANK, YOUR RULES 
With 7 powerful tanks to choose and unlock, stat-boosting patterns and decals, as well as a deep upgrade system, you can decide how your tank rides. Increase your firepower, speed, accuracy and more! 

PLAY YOUR OWN WAY 
Go to war in four different arenas, each with their own choke points and sniping spots. Will you take out your enemies from distance, or drive straight into the fray for rewards and glory? It's up to you in Iron Force. 

IRON FORCE FEATURES: 
• Completely FREE TO PLAY. 
• Play online with friends or just jump into a game with anyone! 
• Take part in 3 vs 3 Team battles or in 6 player Free-for-All mode. 
• Create a Legion with your friends and play together! 
• Practice your skills against intelligent AI bots. 
• 7 powerful tanks to choose from with more coming soon! 
• Increase your tank's firepower, speed, fire rate and more than 100 awesome upgrades. 
• Go to war in one of 4 arenas, watch out for those choke points. 
• 8 in-game power ups to find on the battlefield. 
• Give your tank a bonus boost with specific patterns and decals. 

What are you waiting for, commander?
